summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py gains `from enum import Enum` and a trailing `EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum)` with the eleven members from the spec. botocore/args.py gains the EndpointResolverBuiltins import, a None-tolerant STS predicate (`_should_set_global_sts_endpoint`), and `compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults` at the end of ClientArgsCreator. tests/unit/test_args.py gains TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 18 tests covering every behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py 57 passed; test_regions.py and test_client.py 356 passed. Full tests/unit run: 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py and test_session/test_session_legacy, which also fail with my changes stashed, so they predate this work. Nothing committed. Choices: SDK_ENDPOINT is always a key, with None when absent; the helper calls the bridge's private _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint; the spec's misleadingly named legacy-SDK-endpoint test keeps its name and sets the bundled-data flag to false.
